description: This file defines a builder class for creating and configuring DrugOrder objects within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods to set various properties of a DrugOrder, such as drug, dosing instructions, patient, encounter, and related details, utilizing context-based service lookups.

classes.name: DrugOrderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate the creation and configuration of DrugOrder objects with a fluent API, utilizing context-based service lookups to set various attributes.

methods.name: withDrug
methods.description: Sets the drug for the order based on the provided drug ID.

methods.name: withAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Sets the auto-expire date for the drug order.

methods.name: withDosingInstructions
methods.description: Sets dosing instructions as a string.

methods.name: withDosingType
methods.description: Sets the dosing instructions type via class reference.

methods.name: withQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for the drug order.

methods.name: withQuantityUnits
methods.description: Sets the units for the quantity based on a concept ID.

methods.name: withNumRefills
methods.description: Sets the number of refills allowed.

methods.name: withPatient
methods.description: Associates a patient with the order based on patient ID.

methods.name: withConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with the order.

methods.name: withCareSetting
methods.description: Sets the care setting for the order.

methods.name: withOrderer
methods.description: Sets the orderer (practitioner) based on order ID.

methods.name: withEncounter
methods.description: Associates an encounter with the order.

methods.name: withDateActivated
methods.description: Sets the activation date of the order.

methods.name: withUrgency
methods.description: Sets the urgency level of the order.

methods.name: withScheduledDate
methods.description: Sets a scheduled date for the order.
